doc_friction.issue: The 52/57 whist gap was framed as 'a pattern to test' (3 x prime group orders); the literature already proves patterned-starter (-1 multiplier) designs impossible at both sizes, which earlier runs could have looked up before spending CPU-hours.

notes: Flagship row 4 (league-schedule-generator), item: whist designs 52 and 57. New eval/whist-orbits.c (tabu over several base rounds on Z_m x levels, or over the non-abelian Z_p x| Z_q). Z7 x| Z3 finds 21 in 68 ms; Z19 x| Z3 for 57 stalls at cost 2 in 6 runs (~100 CPU-min); three levels fail at 21-40 and stall at cost 12 for 52; the (a,b)->(-a,b) symmetry never finds 21. Literature (arXiv:1911.07189 survey): no patterned starter at 57 (9 mod 12) or 52 (51 = 3 x 17, 17 = 5 mod 12). eval/ghost-seats.mjs: 57 on design 60 with 3 ghosts caps at 12.15 busy courts of 14 (< 90% whistWorthIt), by counting. No product change; outcome partial because no design was found. Checks: node --test whist.test.mjs 17/17; run_venture_tests league-schedule-generator (see PR); check_posts ok; validate.py ok.

human_equivalent.basis: a combinatorial-design researcher writing a multi-structure tabu search, running it, and checking the Z-cyclic whist literature

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
